title: Calvert Marine Museum

services.name: Admissions
services.desc: Group rates are available for 10 or more paying visitors with at least 2 weeks notice and payment completed in one transaction. Contact the CMM Group Services Coordinator for more

services.name: Venue Rental
services.desc: Create a Website Account - Manage notification subscriptions, save form progress and more. Planning a meeting, conference, party, or wedding? Consider having it here at the Calvert Marine Museum. The museum is a waterfront venue with indoor and outdoor spaces available for special events. An expansive boardwalk joins the museum to Back Creek, offering a scenic view of the waterfront and the historic Drum Point Lighthouse. Having your event at the Calvert Marine Museum supports our education programs and museum growth. The Calvert Marine Museum is a non-profit facility and your rental fees will go directly to keeping our doors open and our programs

services.name: Chesapeake Bay Sailing Craft
services.desc: Working sailing craft were a common sight on the bay at the end of the nineteenth century when well over three thousand could be found. Most of these types have since declined or disappeared. Mr. Brewington, long interested in the maritime history of the bay, provides brief descriptions of the nine most common types,
